candidates.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: SandCore desktop wallpaper, replacement for the rejected artificial-looking dune image.
Primary request: an exceptionally beautiful, unmistakably photographic coastal landscape, like a patiently composed photograph by a skilled nature photographer rather than a polished AI render. Landscape 16:9, target 3840x2160.
Scene: a real temperate Atlantic dune coast on a clear breezy morning, seen from a modest sand dune. A single gently curving sandy crest with sparse irregular tufts of marram grass leads from the bottom left toward the right-hand middle distance. Beyond it lies a broad quiet blue ocean. A spacious pale-to-deep blue sky with a few low, irregular, wind-stretched cumulus clouds occupies almost half the image.
Style: natural RAW landscape photography, 35mm lens, f/11, ordinary daylight, subtle optical softness toward distant horizon. Physically plausible atmospheric haze, no artificial depth blur. Fine irregular sand grains, subtle broken wind ripples, imperfect grass tufts, uneven dune contours, understated distant ocean texture. Slightly imperfect details are essential. Natural colors and sensible contrast.
Composition: iconic simple three-part silhouette, a memorable curved dune, small green grass patches, blue sea and sky; left/top unobstructed for desktop icons. The photographer chose this exact viewpoint thoughtfully. Clear visual hierarchy and very restrained detail.
Avoid: surreal lagoon, impossible sculpted white sand, geometric patterns, mirror water, crystalline cyan water, towering decorative clouds, symmetrical clouds, glowing objects, airbrushed textures, CGI, game render, hyperreal HDR, oversaturation, fantasy, excessive sunbeams, people, buildings, UI, logo, text or watermark.
Output a single finished photographic wallpaper.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: flagship SandCore OS Aurora WHITE theme logo wallpaper, landscape 16:9, target 3840x2160.
Primary request: a beautiful original operating-system brand wallpaper with the assured composition and polished emblem treatment of beloved early-2000s premium workstation desktop wallpapers, newly designed for SandCore. The user specifically wants a premium logo wallpaper for the white Aurora theme.
Backdrop: a serene luminous ice-blue-to-pearl-white atmospheric gradient, slight translucent flowing light sheet gently curves across the lower quarter, soft matte finish. Quiet uncluttered background, broad empty left half for icons. No scene or landscape, no watermark.
Emblem: one distinctive SandCore symbol placed slightly right of center, about one fifth of the image width. A confident simple silhouette: two broad, gracefully tapered dune ridges folded into a compact open triangular spiral, enclosing one small faceted warm amber diamond core. Three pieces maximum, recognizable at small size, strong negative space, no bounding circle or square, no surrounding ring. The crest points upward, one smooth lower edge sweeps left. Original brand, do not resemble Windows, Ubuntu or another existing company logo.
Material: refined three-dimensional satin silver outer ridge edges, luminous translucent cyan inner planes, warm amber central core, restrained crisp specular highlights, gentle diffuse reflection below the floating symbol. Beautiful well-made emblem rather than glass ribbons or tentacles. Clean geometry with fine bevels, elegant proportion, absolutely no complex filigree or cheap metallic chrome.
Composition: generous breathing room, a small subtle core glow, exquisite white/cyan/silver color harmony. Premium tasteful nostalgia together with a contemporary light desktop. Emblem immediately reads as an designed OS logo, not an object lying on a landscape.
Constraints: no letters, words, typography, branding text, UI, border, busy particles, rainbows, lens flares, glitter, star field, heavy bloom, neon, literal sand texture, Windows logo. Single finished wallpaper.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: SandCore Classic theme branded desktop wallpaper, landscape 16:9, target 3840x2160.
Input image 1 is the reference for the SandCore logo silhouette and identity. Preserve the exact overall triangular three-dune spiral and amber diamond core from that image. Redesign the presentation as a tasteful late-1990s / year-2000 operating-system wallpaper.
Backdrop: restrained deep petrol teal across the left side fading gently to muted sea-green toward the lower right, subtle broad blue radial glow behind the emblem. Mostly a quiet flat teal desktop field. No landscape, not a busy sci-fi screen.
Place the same emblem right of center at approximately 23 percent of the image width, surrounded by substantial empty space. Transform it into a crisp, solid, modestly beveled 3D brand mark with silver outer faces, softly shaded navy/teal inner faces, a warm sand-gold center. Keep the excellent original silhouette and the central diamond, but remove the transparent-glass, bright white Aurora treatment, ribbons and reflections from the reference background.
Style: refined original 2000-era workstation brand art; clean slightly angular edges, controlled directional shading, a narrow embossed highlight, modest elegant extrusion depth. An homage to classic Windows 2000 desktop aesthetics combined with SandCore's original cyan and sandy-amber palette, without copying any Microsoft logo or wallpaper. Iconic, confident, calm. Small subtle shadow behind the mark, no ground plane.
Constraints: no logo redesign, no added panels or circles, no text, no lettering, no typography, no Windows logo, no UI, no watermark, no stars, wireframes, circuitry, glitter, lens flare, neon or excess glow. One finished desktop wallpaper.
